intro: Twelve years of research across visible-light communication, the Internet of Things, AI and healthcare informatics: from a Ph.D. on Li-Fi modulation at NIT Karnataka to post-doctoral work on healthcare IoT at the University of Central Florida.

featured.title: IoTaaS: An IoT-as-a-Service Framework for Virtual Experimentation
featured.summary: A framework that offers IoT experiments as a service, so students and researchers can run IoT experiments virtually instead of needing the hardware in front of them.

featured.title: Stage-Wise IoT Solutions for Alzheimer's Disease
featured.summary: Organises IoT-based solutions by the stage of Alzheimer's disease they serve, from early detection to monitoring and care, as a guide for researchers and care providers.

featured.title: Digital Convergence in Dental Informatics: AI, IoT, Digital Twins & LLMs
featured.summary: A study of how artificial intelligence, IoT, digital twins and large language models are coming together in dental care and dental informatics.

featured.title: Continuous Sign-Language Recognition with Leap Motion
featured.summary: Recognises continuous sign language, not just isolated signs, from hand-tracking data captured by a Leap Motion sensor.

featured.title: A Nested-Texture Image-Pattern Optical Camera Communication
featured.summary: Optical camera communication sends data with light that an ordinary camera can read. This work carries the data in nested textures within an image pattern, which a camera then decodes.

featured.title: Hybrid FSK + PWM Modulation for Li-Fi
featured.summary: Combines frequency-shift keying with pulse-width modulation to send data over visible light (Li-Fi), part of the doctoral work on efficient modulation for indoor IoT.

activeProjects.title: Embodied AI Platform (NAO robot)
activeProjects.summary: Turning a NAO V4 humanoid robot into a physical interface for locally hosted AI. The robot listens, speaks and gestures, while speech recognition, a local language model and motion planning run on a server. Next: a 3D digital twin of the robot, document Q&A, emotion recognition and campus deployment.

activeProjects.title: FIT-ARCADE
activeProjects.summary: A fitness arcade in the browser, played with your body. A webcam turns jumps, squats, punches and push-ups into game controls, estimates heart rate from the same camera (rPPG) and adapts each game's difficulty to the player's effort. All video stays on the device.

activeProjects.title: Mobile IPS: indoor positioning
activeProjects.summary: Indoor positioning for Android phones. A building is mapped once with ARCore (walls, walkable floor and Wi-Fi fingerprints); after that, step detection and Wi-Fi matching are fused in a particle filter that cannot walk through walls. Accuracy studies in real buildings are next.

activeProjects.title: Sign Language Translator
activeProjects.summary: Translating continuous sign language into text, building on Best Paper–winning work on continuous sign-language recognition with a Leap Motion hand-tracking sensor (IEEE AIC 2024).

activeProjects.title: ARTHunt: AR Treasure Hunt
activeProjects.summary: A research platform for augmented-reality treasure hunts that run in the browser with no app download, plus a HoloLens 2 version on the same backend. It studies whether web AR raises participation, how a camera power-saver affects battery and heat, and how riddle-based clues support spatial problem-solving.

activeProjects.title: The Last Beacon: IoT training platform
activeProjects.summary: A gamified, story-driven IoT workshop: seven missions on ESP8266/ESP32 boards, a custom Arduino library (BeaconAria) and a real-time 3D facilitator dashboard, with an offline USB fallback for classrooms with poor Wi-Fi. With collaborators at NIT Karnataka, the University of Central Florida and the University of Malta.
